manual_notes: Olomoucine inhibited SUMO3 modification of FEN1.
Desogestrel with ethinyl estradiol increased corticosteroid-binding globulin.
AMD refers to age-related macular degeneration not methyldopa.
Allopurinol suppressed MMP2 expression.
Low oxygen elevated HK2 but HK2 was normalized to KIF2A.
MDA-MB-231 is a cell line not tenamfetamine.
Gentamicin increased COX2 but COX2 was normalized to MT-CO2.
Methysergide inhibited growth hormone secretion.
Pros referred to a plant context not PROS1.
Pemafibrate induced Acadm expression.
RAS was a patient group abbreviation not rasagiline.
Ellagic acid weakly inhibited PLA2 activity with no specific PLA2G1B support.
Cisplatin induced ATF3 and ATF4 rather than CREB5.
A ginsenoside component of American ginseng increased Bax.
Ropivacaine involvement in LRRC4 regulation was inferred through dexmedetomidine reversal.
Triclosan induced Candida CDR1 but it was normalized to a human CDR1 entity.
High-dose formoterol was reported to decrease ubiquitin mRNA but the current study did not.
Calcium-dependent channel gain of function reduced SATB2-expressing neurons.
Pilocarpine decreased Lrp4 but Lrp4 was normalized to CORIN.
E-CAD levels were assessed after vemurafenib but CAD was normalized to CALD1.
RAS refers to renin-angiotensin system not rasagiline.
A resveratrol dimer inhibited BACE1 rather than plain resveratrol.
Atorvastatin reduced CYP46A1 expression.
CYP17A1 was upregulated in temozolomide-resistant cells rather than by temozolomide.
Ornidazole treatment reduced C-reactive protein.
4-AP modulated cyclin D1.
Levocetirizine expanded CD4+CD25+ cells.
ADAMTS4 was the exception not repressed by TSA.
AMT was an aminomethiophene scaffold not indopan.
COD-B downregulated Bcl-2 but COD was an incomplete compound mention.
Hydrogen peroxide did not affect Irr levels and Irr was normalized to INSRR.
CCl4 treatment was mistaken for cefaclor.
Fucose-containing fraction affected ubiquitin-mediated degradation rather than RPS27A expression.
Chemical treatment was generic and Sj GAPDH was not GAPDHS.
Thiazolidinedione upregulated CD36 but CD36 was normalized to SCARB2.
Diazoxide preconditioning upregulated HGF.
Linoleic acid increased CD36 mRNA and surface expression.
Doxorubicin induced PSMA5 phosphorylation sites.
Myc was a transcription factor mention not myricetin.
Iguratimod suppressed ATF-2.
Saline was a control condition in diabetic retina.
Magnesium downregulated TNF alpha but TNF was normalized to TNFSF13B.
Bosutinib may activate c-Raf but Raf was normalized to ZHX2.
IVIg improved permeability mediated by occludin but direct occludin change was not shown.
Rapamycin as an mTOR inhibitor increased PEX2 protein level.
17-AAG likely decreased Nsl1 but Nsl1 was normalized to KANSL1.
Piroxicam was studied for inhibitory effects on ASIC1a channels.
Cinnamaldehyde decreased VEGF expression but VEGFB specificity is uncertain.
Amphetamine occurred inside CART while omentin was the treatment.
TLR2 was an inducing stimulus pathway rather than the object affected by PAF.
Ser72 was a phosphorylation residue and ROCK2 was not affected by serine.
S1P was sphingosine-1-phosphate not MBTPS1.
Rotenone-treated knockout cells had lower Gclc than wild type.
FSH with LH increased Smad2 expression.
Green tea EGCG inhibited migration toward CXCL10 rather than CXCL10 expression.
Apple procyanidins activated caspase-9.
Thiram enhanced TNF alpha but TNF was normalized to TNFSF4.
HNF1 activates alpha1-antitrypsin and was normalized to NF1.
Polyethylene glycol upregulated Ugdh.
DHT increased PSAP expression but PSAP was normalized to MTCH1.
Montelukast reduced TNF alpha but TNF was normalized to TNFSF4.
CAD was coronary artery disease and cholesterol was a biomarker.
Nicotine treatment altered PINK1 localization and accumulation.
Azacitidine was compared with an SMG-1 inhibitor but did not affect SMG1.
ATP levels inhibit the TSC1-TSC2 complex but TSC2 was normalized to SPTLC1.
Astaxanthin induced worm ctl-2 but it was normalized to SLC44A2.
PND15 means postnatal day 15 not NPPA.
Atorvastatin decreased Dbp but Dbp was normalized to HSD17B4.
Adelmidrol reduced TNF alpha but TNF was normalized to TNFSF13.
Domperidone was a comparator and TNF was normalized incorrectly.
Clofibrate inhibited the haptoglobin increase.
CLA was conjugated linoleic acid not clarithromycin.
3-Nitropropionic acid activated the calpain cdk5 pathway but subject was generic acid.
Trehalose elevated synaptophysin expression.
Glyphosate exposure upregulated Shh.
ASK1 was a plant pathway component and not MAP3K5 affected by IAA.
C1 esterase inhibitor blocks bradykinin activation rather than bradykinin affecting it.
Naproxen was identified as a fascin-pathway blocker.
Curcumin inhibited nor-1 expression but nor-1 was normalized to PLSCR1.
Anakinra increased total IFNAR1 levels.
Fluvoxamine increased IL-4 serum levels.
Lovastatin with cholestyramine decreased ABCG8 mRNA.
CCl4 treatment was mistaken for cefaclor.
4-PBA upregulated IFIT1.
Tranilast decreased CD31-positive microvessels.
Nocodazole decreased FBW7 protein expression.
Decitabine changed IRF9 activation timing.
Vilazodone reduced AP-1 related FOS and JUN transcripts.
Indisulam recruited RBM39 to the CUL4-DCAF15 ligase complex.
Cobalt chloride induced PDK1 but PDK1 was normalized to PDPK1.
Magnesium activated Furin not potassium.
Quercetin activates KCNQ2/3 channels.
NAc means nucleus accumbens not acetylcysteine.
Ketamine suppresses TRPC4 channel current.
Manganese induced GST-1 but GST-1 was normalized to CHST1.
Salmon was part of an author name.
Rituximab increased the osteoprotegerin to RANKL ratio.
Aminophylline-treated groups had a higher CD4+ ratio.
MAP means mean arterial pressure not SGSM3.
IL-4 with anti-mu antibody induced cyclin D3.
